t: Version Control for Cursor AI Rules using Git Symlinks
s: This article presents a solution for version-controlling AI assistant configuration files (like Cursor's `.mdc` rules) by using symbolic links. It details why the intuitive approach fails with Git and explains the 'reverse symlink' pattern to keep external configurations within a project's Git repository.
